owner_decision: September 9, 2026: named government statistical APIs are used under their own terms with the owner's registered key; robots.txt does not govern these documented API paths. Keys live in .local/api-keys.json. data.bls.gov QCEW open-data files are included as a documented keyless programmatic path, pending owner confirmation.

api.bls.gov.limits: 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, 20 years/query with a registered key

api.census.gov.limits: 500 queries/day without a key, unlimited with one

data.bls.gov.limits: Documented keyless open-data files; one request per second, files cached locally by hash
data.bls.gov.note: QCEW Open Data Access is documented by BLS for programmatic retrieval and carries no key; the host robots.txt is written for crawlers. Listed here as a keyless documented API path for the owner to confirm or strike.
